subject: system resolver routing in production protected workloads
finding: Moby replaces the user-defined-network resolver configuration with its embedded resolver, retaining other servers as upstreams. GoldenHoop production workloads did not override their resolver file, whereas its accepted owned-resolver component did.
implementation: trusted network-none Rust helper atomically prepares public content-addressed resolver data in the owned agent bundle; workload receives a read-only volume subpath before start; startup/recovery verify exact actual source and configured subpath with actual owned network gateway; no resolver setting grants network authority
scope: native credential DNS/TLS name binding and full Stage gates remain required
